mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_hid_log (terminal_id, people_count,stat_people_count, file_name, timestamp) VALUES (#{terminalId}, #{peopleCount},#{statPeopleCount},#{fileName}, NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT thl.id, thl.terminal_id, tt.terminal_name as terminalNm, thl.people_count, thl.stat_people_count, thl.file_name, thl.timestamp FROM tb_hid_log thl INNER JOIN tb_terminal tt ON thl.terminal_id = tt.terminal_id
AND thl.terminal_id LIKE CONCAT ('%', #{s_terminalId}, '%')
AND tt.terminal_name LIKE CONCAT ('%', #{s_terminalNm}, '%')
ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT thl.terminal_id FROM tb_hid_log thl LEFT JOIN tb_terminal tt ON thl.terminal_id = tt.terminal_id
AND thl.terminal_id LIKE CONCAT ('%', #{s_terminalId}, '%')
AND tt.terminal_name LIKE CONCAT ('%', #{s_terminalNm}, '%')
) sv

WITH last_entries AS ( SELECT DATE(timestamp) AS log_date, terminal_id, MAX(id) AS last_id FROM tb_hid_log WHERE YEAR(timestamp) = #{year} GROUP BY DATE(timestamp), terminal_id ) SELECT months.month AS month, COALESCE(SUM(t.stat_people_count), 0) AS statPeopleCount FROM ( SELECT 1 AS month UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 ) months LEFT JOIN last_entries le ON months.month = MONTH(le.log_date) LEFT JOIN tb_hid_log t ON le.last_id = t.id GROUP BY months.month ORDER BY months.month;
